description: Foundation layer: rewrite src/data/portfolio.js with all CV content in the existing named-export shape, add the two shared primitives every later component needs (an accessible Modal overlay and an ImageWithFallback helper for the 5 missing /public images), and update index.html SEO metadata. Create src/components/Modal.jsx: a reusable overlay. Props { isOpen, onClose, labelledById, children }. When isOpen: render a backdrop div + a panel div with role='dialog' aria-modal='true' (aria-labelledby=labelledById when provided). Close on Escape keydown and on backdrop (not panel) click. Lock document.body scroll while open and restore on close. On open, store document.activeElement, move focus to the panel (or its close button); on close, restore focus. Include a close button with aria-label='Close'. Use a React portal only if trivial; otherwise render inline at the component root (either is fine for this SPA).

Create src/styles/modal.css: backdrop fixed inset:0 with a translucent dark layer and high z-index (above nav's z-index:100), centered panel using var(--surface), 1px var(--border), border-radius ~8px, var(--card-shadow), max-width ~720px, max-height ~85vh with scrollable body, padding consistent with cards; close button styled like the existing .theme-btn circular icon button. No new palette — tokens only. Import this file from Modal.jsx.

Create src/components/ImageWithFallback.jsx: props { src, alt, className, style, fallback }. Track `failed` state; render `fallback` when src is falsy OR the fires onError; otherwise render the with given className/style/alt and onError={()=>setFailed(true)}. This is the single graceful-degradation mechanism for /anantaaa.png,/hotel.jpg,/arcadia.jpg,/bncc.jpg,/c-beginners.jpg.

Edit index.html: set <title> to 'I Gusti Bagus Ananta — Full-Stack Developer' and the meta[name=description] content to a lightweight full-stack-framed description naming the owner. Leave font links and document structure unchanged.

findings:
DONE. Build gate `npm run build` passes (Vite 8 / rolldown). dist/index.html title = 'I Gusti Bagus Ananta — Full-Stack Developer'. No example.com/instagram/bare-domain links remain in src/.

IMPORTANT for FEAT-002:
- Vite 8 (rolldown) treats a MISSING NAMED EXPORT as a HARD BUILD ERROR (not a warning). Any import of a removed export breaks the build. So I could NOT simply delete the old `skills` export while About.jsx still imports it. I kept a backwards-compatible shim in portfolio.js: `export const skills = skillCategories.flatMap((g) => g.items)`. When FEAT-002 rewrites About.jsx to consume `skillCategories`, REMOVE the `skills` import from About.jsx AND delete the `skills` shim export from portfolio.js in the same change so the build stays green.
- Current (pre-FEAT-002) components still reference now-removed object fields that resolve to undefined at runtime but do NOT break the build: Hero.jsx uses personalInfo.heroDesc (now heroHeadline/heroSubtitle/heroSupporting); Projects.jsx uses project.link (now `github`) and renders project.desc/year/tags (year only on P1 Hotel Arca now); Achievements.jsx uses achievement.type/desc/year (new shape: title/issuer/date/note?/image?/icon). FEAT-002 must update these components to the new data shapes.
- New data exports added: skillCategories, education, volunteer; navLinks now has 6 entries (About, Work, Education, Awards, Volunteer, Contact) — revisit navbar.css mobile rule `.nav-links a:not(.theme-wrap):nth-child(-n+3)` which currently hides the first 3 links under 600px.
- personalInfo.role is now 'Computer Science Student | Aspiring Full-Stack Developer'; Footer.jsx (uses role/university/fullName) renders fine, university is now 'BINUS University Malang'.
- New shared primitives ready to use: src/components/Modal.jsx (props: isOpen,onClose,labelledById,children; Escape+backdrop close, body-scroll lock, focus move/restore, .modal-close button) + src/styles/modal.css (z-index 200, above nav's 100); src/components/ImageWithFallback.jsx (props: src,alt,className,style,fallback; renders fallback node on falsy src or img onError) — use for the 5 missing images /anantaaa.png,/hotel.jpg,/arcadia.jpg,/bncc.jpg,/c-beginners.jpg.
- projects[].github is the PROFILE url (https://github.com/nanta765) for all 3; no per-repo urls.
